title: Anchor, baseline, and current portability inventory

tasks.title: Anchor and preserve the checkout
tasks.description: Record branch, HEAD, merge base against prepared anchor, SDK, OS/architecture, git status, submodules, and every unrelated change. Stop rather than reset, clean, or overwrite operator work.

tasks.title: Revalidate the source-reference manifest
tasks.description: Verify every exact path, classify renamed/deleted files, add newly discovered portability surfaces, and update evidence status from Search-confirmed to Inspected where applicable.

tasks.title: Run stable baseline and host characterization
tasks.description: Run restore/build/stable tests on the available Windows host and on real Ubuntu/macOS runners or machines. Capture failures without making portability edits.

tasks.title: Generate the full portability scan
tasks.description: Run the supplied scanner, review every hit, and classify by logical path, physical path, filesystem, secret, process, desktop, hosting, test, or external dependency.

tasks.title: Build the path-field inventory
tasks.description: Map every persisted/configured/runtime string that can represent a route, logical locator, physical path, executable, URL, script, or opaque command. Record writer, reader, comparer, migration owner, and trust boundary.

tasks.title: Build the persistence and migration inventory
tasks.description: Map database columns, control-plane JSON, vault payloads, Data Protection key ring, storage tokens, runtime-node metadata, and host-bound preferences. Include backup/rollback and restart dependencies.

tasks.title: Reconfirm architecture ownership
tasks.description: Use the latest MAF refactor ADRs and project graph to approve owners for platform primitives, security, Workbench presentation, Manager supervision, MAF runtime, Plugins, and Processes semantics.

tasks.title: Issue Gate C0
tasks.description: No implementation starts until all P0/P1 findings are classified, the source anchor is current, baseline evidence is stored, and the revised work graph is internally consistent.
